text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Looking at the bulletin board, I'm 
reminded. Come to think of it, today is 
finally the day of the "Little Kids' Trial 
Enrollment."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Good grief, what a predicament. To 
think so many applied hoping to be guided 
by King. On top of that, they even had to 
hold a lottery!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
There were letters included too, wasn't 
there? Saying how much they admire 
King-san! Everyone's going to be thrilled 
to meet the real deal~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
King Halo is remarkably popular. Many 
parents expressed their wish for their 
children to learn from her unyielding 
racing spirit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a first-class lady, I shall live up to 
their expectations! Are you ready, 
Kita-san? Let us go meet the children!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The trial enrollment began. After 
exchanging brief greetings with the 
children, we guided them through the 
gymnasium, pool, gym, and various other 
facilities, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's been so nervous this whole 
time, they haven't spoken a word... Even 
though they look interested, it seems 
they're too shy to ask questions.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I suppose anyone would get nervous 
standing before someone they look up to. I 
was completely heart-pounding nervous the 
first time I met Teio-san, after all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew... King's aura must be overwhelming 
them, then. ...In that case!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*inhales*——Ohohohoho! Did you honestly 
think you could enter Tracen Academy with 
such timidness!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, very well! This King shall 
personally witness your running!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Though it's outside our scheduled slot, 
I've managed to arrange ten minutes of 
track time. Come, we shall run together! 
Try to keep up!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
W-We're running...? For real? What should 
we do... If we can't run well, will she be 
disappointed in us...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shrinking back, the children murmured 
anxiously. Taken by surprise, they seemed 
flustered.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
............ She definitely has a plan in 
mind. Yeah, I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, relax, just relax! Since 
King-san is inviting us, I promise 
something super fun is waiting ahead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black ran ahead. Chasing after 
her, King Halo closed the distance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... As expected of King-san...! She's 
staying right on my tail!

text_block_list.name: Child with Sparkling Eyes
text_block_list.text:
So fast... Much faster than on TV! It 
feels like the ground is shaking...!

text_block_list.name: Excited Child
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! I-If I train here, could I run 
like that too...!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Now then, what are you all just 
standing around dazing at? Next is your 
turn. We'll be the ones chasing you, you 
know~?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Eh, wah...!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
! H-Haa... Everyone, are you ready? On 
your maaaarks... GO!!

text_block_list.name: Frustrated Child
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu...! They're gonna catch up...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What is this, are you already exhausted?! 
Don't tell me you're going to give up 
here!

text_block_list.name: Frustrated Child
text_block_list.text:
! I-I'm not giving up...! I won't lose, I 
won't lose either—!

text_block_list.name: Excited Child
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! You were so fast! So 
cool! King-san and Kitasan Black-san were 
both so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Excited Child
text_block_list.text:
I want to run more! I want to try doing 
training too. Um, um! Tell us all about 
it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ! Of course!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Now then, let us continue the tour! 
Of course, there will be hands-on training 
too, so prepare yourselves!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good work. The children seemed quite taken 
with you as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm glad. ...At first, since they 
were nervous, I wondered why you made them 
run.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Once they started running, their eyes 
began sparkling, they showed 
frustration... Seeing those faces, I 
understood your intentions, King-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Those kids are just like us... They're 
horse girls after all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! Sometimes you have to give them 
a push on the back, even if it's a bit 
forceful.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is what first-class... what mature 
handling feels like! I want to become 
someone who can handle things like that 
too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, isn't that nice. Someday, someone 
who looks up to you might enroll here 
too...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh. For that occasion, you had best learn 
the ways of a first-class lady! Ohohoho!
